UML, Unified Modeling Language, is a standardized visual representation used to describe various aspects of software architecture.
This page contains reference material for basic implementation of UML.

[Official UML Documentation](https://www.omg.org/spec/UML/)

## Types of Diagrams

### Structure Diagrams

- Class Diagram
- Object Diagram
- Component Diagram
- Composite Structure Diagram
- Package Diagram
- Deployment Diagram.

### Behavior Diagrams

- Use Case Diagram
- Activity Diagram
- State Machine Diagram.

### Interaction Diagrams

Derived from Behavior Diagram

- Sequence Diagram
- Communication Diagram
- Timing Diagram
- Interaction Overview Diagram

## Class Diagram Terminology

### Association

Association is when two classes know about each other and need to communicate, but there is no strong relationship.

__Example__

`ClassA` uses functions from `DebugClass`. `ClassA` knows about debug class, but not vice versa.

@startuml
hide circle
hide members
class ClassA
class DebugClass
ClassA <-- DebugClass
@enduml

#### Aggregation

Aggregation is a subset of association. Implies that the child can exist independently of the parent. This relationship does not indicated that there is ownership between classes.

__Arrowhead Representation__

Unfilled diamond on the side of the parent.

__Example__

@startuml
hide circle
hide members
Human o-- Rabbit
@enduml

The rabbit will still exist if the human is deleted.

#### Composition

Composition is a subset of association. Implies that the child cannot exist without the parent.

__Arrowhead Representation__

Solid diamond shape on the side of the parent.

__Example__

@startuml
hide circle
hide members
Rabbit *-- Ear
Rabbit *-- Tail
@enduml
